Dear Mr. Akagi,

Reference a query made sometime
ago by Mr. Hashizumi on behalf of Manchukuo
Authorities as to the arrival here from Mukden
of Dr. Simpson, a British doctor attached to
Mukden Hospital, I informed Mr. Hashizumi that
I was reluctant to give him the names of the
friends or guarantors of Dr. Simpson until
I had the consent of these gentlemen to do so.

Mr. Hashizumi put forward the rather
peculiar argument that if I refused, his report
to Manchukuo would perhaps be an adverse one.

I have now obtained the consent of the
friends concerned and forward hereunder their
names for transmission to the Consulate. I find
that Dr. Simpson is a man of repute and very
highly spoken of locally.

J. E. Loucks, Standard-Vacuum Oil Co.,
94 Canton Road.

J. F. McKinn, - do -

D. Wheldon, Asiatic Petroleum Co.
(North China) Ltd.,
1 The Bund.

（批：FILE）

Yours sincerely,

亲爱的赤城先生：

关于桥住美先生此前代表满洲国当局就辛普森医生（Dr. Simpson，一位隶属于奉天医院的英国医生）从奉天抵达此处一事所提出的查询，我曾告知桥住美先生，在征得这些绅士同意之前，我不愿向他提供辛普森医生的朋友或担保人的姓名。

桥住美先生提出了一个相当奇特的论点，即如果我拒绝，他向满洲国提交的报告可能会是不利的。

我现在已征得相关朋友的同意，现将他们的姓名列于下方，以便转交领事馆。我发现辛普森医生是一位享有声誉的人，在当地备受推崇。

J. E. Loucks，标准真空石油公司，
广东路94号。

J. F. McKinn，同上

D. Wheldon，亚细亚火油公司（华北）有限公司，
外滩1号。

（批注：归档）

此致
敬礼，

Date September 1, 1938.

SECRET REPORT

Subject Dr. C. F. SIMPSON - movements of.

Made by D.S. Hocking Forwarded by Inspector E Taylor

Dr. C. F. SIMPSON, concerning whom assistance was rendered to the Japanese Consular Police on 26-8-38, departed from Shanghai on the morning of August 30, taking passage to England aboard the P.& O. liner "Corfu". During his stay in Shanghai (August 26 to 30), Dr. Simpson resided at the Palace Hotel; his movements were normal and gave no indication that he might have been in Shanghai for any other reason than to await the sailing of the s.s. "Corfu". It is learned that he is at present on long leave which he intends to spend in England.

For the past 19 or 20 years Dr. Simpson has been connected with the Mukden Hospital and is a recognized authority on affairs in Manchoukuo generally. It is confidentially learned, that on account of the above reason he has, since 1935, been under constant surveillance of the Japanese Secret Service in Manchoukuo, who have caused him numerous hindrances in the form of petty obstacles placed in his path as regards his medical work.

日期 1938年9月1日。

秘密报告

主题 C. F. 辛普森医生 - 行踪。

制作人 D.S. Hocking 呈报人 Inspector E Taylor

C. F. 辛普森医生，警务处于1938年8月26日曾就其事宜向日本领事警察提供协助，已于8月30日上午离开上海，乘坐半岛与东方轮船公司（P.& O.）的“科孚”号（Corfu）邮轮前往英国。辛普森医生在上海停留期间（8月26日至30日），住在华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）；他的行动正常，没有任何迹象表明他在上海是为了等待“科孚”号轮船启航以外的任何其他原因。据悉，他目前正在休长假，打算在英国度过。

在过去19或20年里，辛普森医生一直与奉天医院有关联，并且是公认的满洲国一般事务的权威人士。据密悉，出于上述原因，自1935年以来，他一直受到日本特务机关在满洲国的持续监视，这些特务在他的医疗工作方面设置了许多细小的障碍，给他造成了诸多阻碍。

归档
D.R.
9月1日。

D. S. Hocking
D. S.

D.C. (特别科)。
特别科副主管助理

Subject Police Assistance requested by the Japanese Consular Police
        regarding a British subject named C.N. Simpson.
Made by D. S. Kamashita    Forwarded by [签名]

At 11.40 a.m. today, Mr. Hashizume, chancellor of
the Japanese Consular Police, telephoned to the effect that
a British subject named C.N. Simpson is due to arrive in
Shanghai from Dairen on board the s.s. "Tsingtao Maru",
which will berth at the D.K.K. Whangpoo Wharf, Yangtsepoo
Road, during the afternoon of August 26.    He is expected
to reside at the Palace Hotel.

Mr. Hashizume further stated that he would be
grateful if the Municipal Police would keep a careful watch
on the movements of Simpson and furnish information regarding
his movements in Shanghai to the Consular Police, because he
is suspected by the Japanese authorities to be a communist
agent.

D. Kamashita
D.    S.

报告                        日期 1938年8月25日。

主题 日本领事警察请求警方协助
        涉及一名名为 C.N. Simpson 的英国臣民。
制作人 D. S. Kamashita    呈报人 [签名]

今天上午11时40分，日本领事警察书记官桥住美先生致电称，一名名为 C.N. Simpson 的英国臣民预计将于8月26日下午乘坐“青岛丸”号（s.s. "Tsingtao Maru"）轮船从大连抵达上海，该船将停靠在杨树浦路的大连汽船株式会社黄浦码头（D.K.K. Whangpoo Wharf）。预计他将入住华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）。

桥住美先生进一步表示，如果工部局警务处能密切监视辛普森的行踪，并向领事警察提供其在上海的行踪信息，他将不胜感激，因为日本当局怀疑他是一名共产主义特工。

D. Kamashita
D.    S.

8月26日。
8月25日。

D. C. (特别科)。
